scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres && sleep 2 && npm run db:push && npm run generate
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n turbo,stripe "turbo run dev" "stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/api/stripe/webhook"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run db:seed && concurrently -k -n turbo,stripe "turbo run dev" "stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/api/stripe/webhook"
